# PostprocessingParameters { #valley_floor.PostprocessingParameters }

```python
PostprocessingParameters(min_size=40000, max_slope=12.0)
```

Parameters for postprocessing the valley floor raster.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                                      |
|-----------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| min_size  | int    | Holes smaller than this size in square meters are filled in as valley floor.                                     |
| max_slope | float  | Maximum slope in degrees. Pixels exceeding this are excluded from the valley floor regardless of other criteria. |
